summary: A volunteer who called the newspaper for a meeting place sees an editor at the meeting an hour later.
realLife: The Washington County report recounts a call to the Delta Democrat Times for the unannounced location and records associate editor Hodding Carter III at the convention.
gates: A caller gets no location before a meeting that a reporter attends.
inGame: needs: a notice inquiry, what the desk knew then and the editor’s attendance.

turns.what: The volunteer relays it to the delegates.
turns.pulledBy: The desk obtains the room before the caller hangs up.
turns.writesBack: The notice log records who received it in time.

turns.what: The paper publishes a correction for its readers.
turns.pulledBy: The editor learns the place only after the opening.
turns.writesBack: The published notice records when the information became available.
